headline: Ambit prefers Pine Labs over Paytm amid UPI pricing shifts
hook: New UPI pricing proposal hits fintech stocks

modes.bear: New transaction fees could reduce merchant adoption of UPI, hurting overall transaction volumes for fintech players.

modes.simple: The government is considering a new fee for business-to-business UPI payments. This news caused fintech stocks to fall, as investors worry it might hurt the profits of companies like Paytm.

summary: Reports suggest a proposed flat ₹5 charge for merchant-to-merchant UPI transactions. This potential shift in pricing structure caused shares of Paytm, Pine Labs, and MobiKwik to drop by up to 10% last week. Ambit Capital has signaled a preference for Pine Labs over Paytm in light of these regulatory and business model developments. The move highlights the sensitivity of fintech valuations to changes in UPI monetization policies.
why_it_matters: New UPI merchant fees could compress margins for payment providers.
winners_losers: Pine Labs gains preference / Paytm hurt
